tooltip.no_24_heli.pilot_goggles: Right-click to equip in the goggles slot · First- and third-person night vision
tooltip.no_24_heli.pilot_headset: Right-click to equip in the headset slot · Compatible with goggles
hud.no_24_heli.title: NO.24 / FLIGHT
message.no_24_heli.gear_grounded: Cannot retract landing gear while grounded. Take off first.
message.no_24_heli.parts_missing: Need one fuselage, rotor, tail rotor, engine and fuel tank.
message.no_24_heli.assembled: Helicopter assembled. Add fuel and inspect components.
message.no_24_heli.start: Engine started. Wait for full rotor RPM before lifting collective.
message.no_24_heli.start_power_low: Engine started, but current component condition and weather leave insufficient lift. Takeoff may be impossible. Repair the main rotor and engine first.
message.no_24_heli.takeoff_power_low: Current component condition and weather leave insufficient lift. Takeoff may be impossible. Repair the main rotor and engine first.
message.no_24_heli.auto_rotor_damaged: Auto flight unavailable: main rotor condition is below 70%. Repair it first.
message.no_24_heli.start_failed: Check fuel, engine and main rotor.
message.no_24_heli.rope_unsafe: Deploy above 3 and up to 24 blocks AGL, below 2 m/s horizontal and 1.5 m/s vertical
message.no_24_heli.emergency_repair: Emergency repair complete. Repair fuel leaks on the ground.
message.no_24_heli.ground_only: Land and wait for the rotor to stop.
warning.no_24_heli.tail: TAIL FAILURE - use Q / E pedals
warning.no_24_heli.takeoff_power: INSUFFICIENT LIFT - takeoff may be impossible; repair first
warning.no_24_heli.landing_blocked: Landing paused: entity below. Clear to resume; input or K cancels
warning.no_24_heli.autorotation: POWER LOST - lower collective, flare before touchdown
screen.no_24_heli.local: Local default; applied when entering a world
screen.no_24_heli.readonly: Explosion block damage and fire: host / operator only
screen.no_24_heli.explanation: Off disables block damage and fire; explosion damage remains
screen.no_24_heli.difficulty_hint: Flight mode is personal; Zobayan disables assists
message.no_24_heli.recovered: Helicopter recovered with fuel, damage, paint and cargo.
message.no_24_heli.recover_unsafe: Unload crew, stop moving, shut down and wait for the rotor. Water recovery is supported.
message.no_24_heli.exit_warning: Danger: airborne exit! Release Shift and press again within 3 seconds to jump.
message.no_24_heli.autopilot_on: Autopilot engaged. Braking while a detour is planned. Manual input takes over.
message.no_24_heli.autopilot_unavailable: Set a waypoint, start the engine and climb at least 10 blocks above ground. Only the pilot can engage autopilot with controls released.
message.no_24_heli.waypoint_set: Waypoint set. Press the autopilot key to navigate.
message.no_24_heli.restricted: Restricted airspace! Leave the radar zone.
screen.no_24_heli.radar_readonly: Only the owner or an operator can edit
screen.no_24_heli.map_hint: Drag: pan · Click H: set waypoint · Right click: waypoint · Scroll: zoom · M: close
screen.no_24_heli.map_legend: White arrow: you · Orange arrow: heli · Cyan circle H: helipad · Yellow: waypoint · Red: zone
message.no_24_heli.auto_takeoff: Auto takeoff: spool up, then climb 20 blocks. Overhead obstruction aborts; input or auto-flight key cancels.
message.no_24_heli.auto_takeoff_blocked: Insufficient overhead clearance. Auto takeoff ended.
message.no_24_heli.auto_landing: Auto landing: descend vertically, then shut down on touchdown.
message.no_24_heli.auto_unsafe: Auto flight unavailable: check fuel, parts, overhead clearance and a flat dry landing area.
message.no_24_heli.auto_mode_disabled: Auto takeoff/landing is disabled in Mamba and Zobayan modes.
message.no_24_heli.assists_disabled: All flight assists and autopilot are disabled in Zobayan mode.
radio.no_24_heli.hint: Hold Tab and point · Release to select · Center: off
radio.no_24_heli.missing: Slot %s has no MP3. See the radio setup in README.
radio.no_24_heli.downloading: Receiving server radio slot %s; playback starts when ready.
radio.no_24_heli.download_failed: Could not receive server radio slot %s. Retrying shortly.
message.no_24_heli.rope_exit_warning: Over 3 blocks above ground! Release Shift and press again within 3 seconds to detach
message.no_24_heli.route_blocked: No safe route: braking to hover while awaiting replanning
message.no_24_heli.route_planning: In path planning. Braking to hover while waiting.
message.no_24_heli.route_arrived: Waypoint reached. Autopilot off; maintaining hover.
message.no_24_heli.route_start_forbidden: Planning failed: start is inside or on a restricted circle. Leave manually and retry.
message.no_24_heli.route_goal_forbidden: Planning failed: goal is inside or on a restricted circle. Choose another waypoint.
message.no_24_heli.route_both_forbidden: Planning failed: both start and goal are inside or on restricted circles.
message.no_24_heli.route_start_enclosed: Planning failed: start is enclosed by restricted airspace and cannot reach the goal.
message.no_24_heli.route_goal_enclosed: Planning failed: goal is enclosed by restricted airspace and cannot be reached from the start.
message.no_24_heli.route_different_enclo: Planning failed: start and goal are in disconnected enclosed regions.
message.no_24_heli.route_grid_resolution: Safety clearance or grid resolution cannot represent a traversable route. Check endpoint clearance, passage width and gridCellSize.
message.no_24_heli.route_cell_limit: Planning failed: required grid exceeds pathMaxCells.
message.no_24_heli.route_node_limit: Planning failed: visited nodes exceed pathMaxNodes.
message.no_24_heli.route_geometry_limit: Planning failed: circle rasterization or enclosure checks exceed the geometry budget.
message.no_24_heli.route_busy: Planning queue is full. Braking to hover, then retrying automatically.
message.no_24_heli.route_interrupted: Route planning interrupted. Braking to hover while waiting.
message.no_24_heli.route_invalid_input: Planning failed: invalid coordinates, circles or planning parameters.
message.no_24_heli.route_failed: Route planning failed unexpectedly. Braking to hover; check the server log.
message.no_24_heli.autopilot_low: Autopilot requires at least 10 blocks of ground clearance.
message.no_24_heli.pad_space: Clear a 10-block diameter area for the helipad.
message.no_24_heli.pad_restricted: The helipad overlaps or touches a no-fly zone; placement and waypoint selection are blocked.
message.no_24_heli.route_trajectory_unsa: No safely flyable curve with sufficient clearance. Holding position; adjust the waypoint or grid resolution.
hud.no_24_heli.parachute_controls: W/S glide/brake and reverse · A/D turn · Remove pack after landing to collect canopy
hud.no_24_heli.parachute_pull_after: rapidly to pull the canopy open
item.no_24_heli.parachute_unpacked: Unpacked: hold right-click in hand for 5 seconds before equipping
item.no_24_heli.parachute_lost: Canopy lost: permanently broken; cannot repair or repack
advancement.no_24_heli.legend_never_fall: Crash a helicopter while piloting it for the first time.
advancement.no_24_heli.tribute_to_legend: Successfully apply the purple and gold livery for the first time.
Deploy a parachute for the first time.
key.no_24_heli.cabin_door: Toggle cabin door on this side
message.no_24_heli.door_closed: Open the cabin door on your side first
message.no_24_heli.door_wait: Wait for the cabin door to open fully
message.no_24_heli.door_busy: Someone is boarding or exiting; the door must stay open
message.no_24_heli.side_full: Seats on this side are full; board from the other side
message.no_24_heli.door_exit_blocked: The exit on this side is blocked
